releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v6.5.2 Fixes & UI Enhancements:
- Card Header Overlap Fix: Strict width boundary and text ellipsis on all card titles prevent any collision with status pills.
- Battery Conservation Active State: Highlighting active 60% / 80% / 100% modes with checkmark pills and card badges.
- Instant Battery Diagnostics: Synchronous ACPI hardware capacity readings at startup eliminate 'Querying...' lag.
- Universal Active Badges across presets, GPU profiles, fan modes, and CPU power plans.
